_schema.name: Deterministic per-subsection paragraph + proposition verification ledger (2.2)
_schema.shape: paragraphs keyed P1..Pn; each has plan fields (intent/serves/boundary/thin_claim/guardrails) + propositions[] + prose_gate + final_prose + prose_status.
_schema.gate_rule: final_prose stays EMPTY and prose_status=BLOCKED until every proposition is SUPPORTED (external-NLM/legal), confirmed-CALLBACK (already SUPPORTED in 2.1), or explicitly DEFINITIONAL/INTERNAL/FRAMING (write-time accuracy pass).
prop_types: callback-verified (already SUPPORTED in 2.1; no new query)
internal-hypothesis (a prediction we TEST, not a claim we cite)
_schema.status: PHASE-3 PLANNED (paragraph purposes + atomic prop chains). NOT ratified, NOT prose-written. Ratification deferred to end (all subsections).

title: Hypothesis Development

hard_rules: ONE PARAGRAPH AT A TIME when verifying/writing. Do not batch.
RULE 1 verify-first: no prose until every proposition is verified/confirmed + recorded.
RULE 2 show-first: show each drafted paragraph before it enters thesis_draft.tex.
NLM is SOLE authority for papers; numbers never typed from memory; author names never expanded from memory.
_governing.coherence_rules_in_force: RULE-COH-1..8 from tmp/section2_subsection_plan.json. Most-load-bearing here: COH-1 (no re-review of 2.1 papers -> callbacks), COH-2 (predicts a PATTERN, never a cause), COH-5 (scrutiny = confound, not a P7 reading; rule-out != mechanism), COH-6 (forward-ref the residual to 2.3), COH-8 (scrutiny VOLUME != UncQue word-uncertainty).

_plan.section_job: Convert the 2.1 framework into formal, falsifiable predictions about WHERE/WHEN the language signal appears -- never WHY. Each hypothesis: a prediction (direction + where/when) + the prior empirical contrast that makes it non-obvious, leaning on contrasts 2.1 already set up.
_plan.spine: P1 funnel -> P2 H1 (anticipatory run-up) -> P3 H1a (cash-concentration) -> P4 H1b (differential timing/two clocks) -> P5 scrutiny competing-hypothesis (the rival 4.1 rules out).
_plan.serves: Falsifiable claims with stakes; the bridge to the 2.4 designs (which map each design to a hypothesis).
_plan.boundary: Predictions only. Do NOT define the measure (2.3) or estimator (2.4); never assert a cause.
_plan.thin_claim: H1a = concentration not strict specificity; no hypothesis asserts a cause; the scrutiny alternative is a real competing hypothesis, not a strawman.
_plan.division_of_labor: 2.1 DEVELOPED both dimensions (P3 anticipatory, P5 cash + two clocks) and the contrasts (P6 thewissen/keown; P2 matsumoto). 2.2 ADDS only: formal falsifiable hypotheses + the scrutiny competing-hypothesis. It does NOT re-review any 2.1 paper.
_plan.estimands_to_define: PreAnnounceQtr = 1[e = -1] (e = call quarter - first-deal announce quarter). Define precisely; no equations here.

thewissen2024.verified_fact: stock bidders inflate disclosure tone ~15% in the year before a stock-for-stock announcement (deliberate tone management).

harford1999.ref: Harford, J. (1999). Corporate cash reserves and acquisitions. Journal of Finance 54(6):1969-1997.
harford1999.verified_fact: firms accumulate cash above a normal-holdings baseline; cash-rich firms are more likely to acquire (by-product of retained FCF, NOT saving-to-fund).

keown1981.verified_fact: roughly half the market's reaction to a merger occurs before its first public announcement -- but in PRICES, not language.

matsumoto2011.verified_fact: the Q&A/discussion carries information content beyond the presentation (analyst questioning is informative).

P1.lit_body: none new -- funnel from the 2.1 framework
P1.intent: Bridge from 2.1's two developed dimensions to formal, falsifiable predictions about where/when the language signal appears (not why). State the empirical anchor and the descriptive register.
P1.serves: Sets up H1/H1a/H1b (P2-P4) and the scrutiny rival (P5); declares the predictions are tested in 2.4.
P1.boundary: No measure (2.3), no estimator/equation (2.4); no cause.
P1.thin_claim: We predict a PATTERN (where/when), read descriptively (callback P7).
guardrails: RULE-COH-6: 'residual' is named here but DEFINED in 2.3 -> light forward-pointer only.

propositions.statement: The 2.1 framework's two dimensions (anticipatory timing x cash-concentration) yield testable predictions about WHERE and WHEN a CEO Q&A language signal appears, not why.
propositions.verification_plan: Internal/derived from 2.1; no external cite. Write-time accuracy pass only.

propositions.statement: Define PreAnnounceQtr = 1[e = -1], the call quarter immediately before the firm's first >=50%-cash acquisition announcement (e = call quarter - announce quarter).
propositions.role_in_paragraph: The empirical timing anchor used by every hypothesis.
propositions.verification_plan: Definitional; matches the design in gen_empire_did_table.py (e==-1). No NLM.

propositions.statement: The predictions are stated as falsifiable hypotheses (H1, H1a, H1b) and tested by the 2.4 designs, read in descriptive/correlational terms.
propositions.verification_plan: Framing; callback to P7 register. Write-time accuracy pass.

P2.intent: State H1 (the anticipatory run-up) and ground its non-obviousness against thewissen's deliberate tone-management finding (opposite register).
P2.serves: The first and central falsifiable prediction; maps to the 2.4 main run-up design + claim C2.
P2.boundary: Direction + where/when only; no measure definition; no cause.
P2.thin_claim: Predicts elevation, correlational, within-firm; cash arm (stock = placebo handled in P3).
guardrails: RULE-COH-1: thewissen is a CALLBACK (P6) -> reference the contrast, do not re-review.

propositions.statement: H1: residual CEO Q&A uncertainty (UncResCEO) is elevated in the pre-announcement quarter of cash acquirers, relative to their own other quarters.
propositions.verification_plan: Prediction we TEST (claim C2 is the result, not a cite). No NLM. Forward-ref residual to 2.3.

propositions.statement: Prior work shows stock bidders deliberately inflate disclosure tone (~15%) before stock-for-stock deals; H1 predicts the opposite register -- unmanaged uncertainty, before cash deals.
propositions.verification_plan: CALLBACK -- the ~15% tone fact is already SUPPORTED in 2.1 P6. No new query; reference only.

propositions.statement: H1 is non-obvious because the literature documents deliberate, strategic tone management, whereas H1 predicts involuntary uncertainty surfacing under the disclosure bind.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: States the stakes / why H1 is not mechanical.
propositions.verification_plan: Framing; rests on P2.1+P2.2. Write-time accuracy pass.

P3.intent: State H1a (the run-up concentrates in cash deals vs stock) as a formal differential prediction; keep it concentration not strict specificity; EFFECT not CAUSE.
P3.serves: Maps to the 2.4 pooled interacted design + claim C6 (the formal cash-specificity test).
P3.boundary: Differential direction only; no cause; no measure/estimator.
P3.thin_claim: Concentration, not strict specificity; supportive-not-definitive (imprecise stock arm); mechanism open.
guardrails: RULE-COH-1: harford + placebo logic = CALLBACK P5.
EFFECT-not-CAUSE: H1a is about the run-up concentrating in cash, NOT that the cash build-up itself is cash-specific (C6 cause leg 0.0064 n.s.).

propositions.statement: H1a: the pre-announcement uncertainty run-up is stronger for cash acquirers than for stock acquirers.
propositions.verification_plan: Prediction we TEST (claim C6). No NLM.

propositions.statement: Cash bids draw on an accumulated cash position while stock exchanges need not, making the stock deal a placebo: the same disclosure bind, minus the cash commitment.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Grounds why cash vs stock is the right contrast.
propositions.verification_plan: CALLBACK -- harford + placebo logic already SUPPORTED/developed in 2.1 P5. No new query.

propositions.statement: H1a concerns the EFFECT (the run-up concentrating in cash deals), framed as concentration not strict specificity; it does NOT claim the cash build-up itself is cash-specific, and asserts no cause.
propositions.verification_plan: Framing; callback to P5 ('why they differ left open') + P7 (no mechanism). Write-time pass.

P4.lit_body: two clocks; distinguish from price run-up (CALLBACK P6 / keown1981)
P4.intent: State H1b (differential timing): uncertainty resolves at announcement (information clock), cash persists to completion (transaction clock); distinguish from price leakage (we track language, not price).
P4.serves: Maps to the 2.4 event-study design + claim C1 (the strongest, two-tailed result).
P4.boundary: Timing prediction only; no cause; no estimator.
P4.thin_claim: Round-trip contrast; do NOT over-read the negative POST overshoot.
guardrails: RULE-COH-1: keown + two-clock concept = CALLBACK (P6/P5); formalize into an event-time test, do not re-explain.
C1 caution: do NOT over-read POST (-0.0250*) as a finding.

propositions.statement: H1b: residual Q&A uncertainty resolves at announcement (elevated pre, gone post), while the acquirer's cash persists until the deal is paid at completion -- the two run on different clocks.
propositions.verification_plan: Prediction we TEST (claim C1). No NLM.

propositions.statement: Prices are known to move ahead of deals (roughly half the reaction precedes announcement), but that anticipatory signal lives in prices; H1b tracks LANGUAGE, a distinct channel.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Distinguishes the contribution from price run-up/leakage.
propositions.verification_plan: CALLBACK -- keown 'half before announcement, in prices' already SUPPORTED in 2.1 P6. No new query.

propositions.statement: The cash-persistence leg is partly mechanical (cash physically leaves at closing); and the post-announcement uncertainty undershoot is not to be over-read.
propositions.verification_plan: Framing; from claim_findings_ledger C1 risks. Write-time pass.

P5.lit_body: the competing analyst-scrutiny hypothesis (NEW; matsumoto2011 CALLBACK P2)
P5.intent: State the competing analyst-scrutiny reading formally as the rival 4.1 tests and rules out -- positioned as a confound, not a P7 reading, and not a mechanism claim.
P5.serves: Gives the 4.1 rule-out a home; pairs with the 2.5.4 scrutiny construct.
P5.boundary: State the rival hypothesis only; the construct definition lives in 2.5, the test/results in 4.1; NOT a 4th estimating equation in 2.4.
P5.thin_claim: Real competing hypothesis (not a strawman); ruling it out does NOT establish our mechanism.
guardrails: RULE-COH-5: scrutiny is a CONFOUND, distinct from P7's two equivalent readings; rule-out != mechanism.
RULE-COH-8: scrutiny (CashScrutiny = cash-question VOLUME) is distinct from UncQue (question-language uncertainty, already an eq-4 control).

propositions.statement: Competing hypothesis (analyst scrutiny): the pre-announcement uncertainty rise reflects analysts asking more or harder cash-related questions, mechanically eliciting hedged answers, rather than the disclosure bind.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: States the rival to be ruled out.
propositions.verification_plan: A rival prediction we TEST in 4.1 (claim C4). No NLM.

propositions.statement: This scrutiny channel is a confound the 4.1 design tests and rules out; it is distinct from the two observationally-equivalent readings of 2.1 (compliance-constrained vs strategic silence), and ruling it out does not establish a mechanism.

Cash scrutiny (the volume/topic of cash questions) is distinct from analyst-question uncertainty language (UncQue), which the residual already nets out by construction; so the rule-out targets the question-volume path and is non-redundant.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Reconciles the rival with the eq-4 control set.
propositions.verification_plan: Framing; RULE-COH-8; rests on the NLM-verified eq-4 control set (tmp/nlm_dwz_equations.json). Confirm CashScrutiny is a volume measure at write-time (gen_empire_did_table.py: CashScrutiny = % analyst Q&A turns on cash).

propositions.statement: Analyst questioning is a genuine, informative force on calls, which is what makes the scrutiny channel a credible rival rather than a strawman.
propositions.verification_plan: CALLBACK -- matsumoto Q&A information content already SUPPORTED in 2.1 P2. No new query.
